name: HABITAT · browser bridge
summary: Connect HABITAT to ChatGPT, search and Translate, with optional Facebook contact avatars from Chrome.
description:
HABITAT Browser Bridge connects the free HABITAT desktop app for Windows to your existing Chrome sessions. Install the desktop app from https://github.com/aesgalexis/habitat/releases/latest before using this extension.

With the connection enabled, you can:
• Send messages from HABITAT to your linked ChatGPT conversation and read the resulting replies in the desktop app.
• Search Google and YouTube from HABITAT and view titles, links and descriptions there.
• Translate text using the Google Translate page.

The extension explains what is shared before you enable it. Requests and results pass between Chrome and HABITAT on this computer through a local connection. There is no HABITAT cloud backend, advertising or analytics. The supported websites receive the text needed for your requests under their own privacy policies.

Requires Windows, the HABITAT desktop app and Chrome 120 or later. ChatGPT requires your own signed-in session. The extension does not provide a ChatGPT account or subscription and does not bypass website limits, consent screens or verification. No API key is required.

Chrome's debugger permission keeps only the search or translation page handling your request active in the background; it is released when that request ends. You can disconnect the extension at any time. See the privacy policy for the data flow and storage details.

HABITAT is an independent project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or Google.

Optional Facebook contacts: grant Facebook site access in the extension popup and open the Facebook widget in HABITAT to display the avatars loaded in the Contacts panel or All friends list. Messages are not read. Disable Facebook contacts in the popup to revoke access. HABITAT is not affiliated with Meta.
singlePurpose: Connect HABITAT to the user's supported Chrome sessions for requested actions and opted-in automatic contact observations, returning content only to the same local Windows app.

permissions.storage: Save the user's explicit connection choice, local pairing key, linked ChatGPT tab/address and temporary search/translation tab identifiers. Extension local/session storage is used; Chrome sync storage is not used.
permissions.tabs: Find and validate the active or already linked ChatGPT conversation and the Google, YouTube and Translate tabs used for a desktop request. Restore the linked page only after an explicit Open in browser action and close dedicated search tabs after Clear search. No browsing history is collected or uploaded.
permissions.scripting: Inject only the packaged reader/composer code into supported pages to submit the exact user request and read its resulting content, and recover the ChatGPT content script after an extension update. No remote code is downloaded or evaluated.
permissions.debugger: Attach only to the Google Search, YouTube results or Google Translate tab handling the current user request and send Emulation.setFocusEmulationEnabled so the page can complete while Chrome is in the background. No network, password or unrelated-tab inspection is performed. Focus emulation is disabled and the debugger detached on completion, cancellation or failure.
permissions.alarms: Restore the authenticated local desktop connection when the MV3 worker restarts. The alarms do not trigger searches, translations or chat messages.
permissions.host_permissions: 127.0.0.1:8765 is the same-computer HABITAT desktop bridge. chatgpt.com is the user's linked conversation. Google Search, YouTube results and Google Translate are the supported pages used for explicit desktop requests. No all-sites host permission is requested.
permissions.optional_host_permissions: Optional facebook.com/www.facebook.com, mail.google.com and contacts.google.com access observes loaded people in open provider tabs while enabled. Facebook supplies names, photo addresses and profile links; Gmail supplies correspondent names/emails from mail-list rows; Google Contacts supplies loaded contact rows. No subjects, snippets, mail bodies, cookies or private endpoints are read. Automatic collection never opens, scrolls or navigates provider tabs. Enable access once in Chrome, disable it in the popup or switch a source Off in HABITAT. Saved contact provenance and earlier versions remain locally. Coverage is partial.

dataDisclosures: Authentication information (local desktop pairing key only)
Personal communications (submitted chat messages and resulting replies)
Web history (linked conversation and request page addresses only)
Website content (requested search results and translations)
Personal information (opted-in automatic Facebook, Gmail and Google Contacts names, emails, phones, source account identity, photo addresses and available profile links)
reviewerInstructions: Requires Windows and Chrome 120+. Install the free HABITAT desktop companion from the GitHub Releases link. For public desktop version 0.9.1, open Preferences > Browser and select Google Chrome explicitly; the upcoming desktop update uses Chrome automatically. Install this extension, select Enable connection on its welcome page, and leave HABITAT running. Google, YouTube and Translate work without a ChatGPT tab. Submit synthetic queries such as Microsoft WinUI documentation and Microsoft Windows developer, or translate Hello world. Results return inside HABITAT; Clear search closes the dedicated search tab. To test ChatGPT, sign into your own test account on chatgpt.com and open an existing conversation, then submit a synthetic message from HABITAT. No developer account credentials, subscription or API key are provided or required by HABITAT. Website sign-in/consent/verification may require normal user action. Disconnect in the extension popup stops subsequent jobs. The public source and local bridge implementation are in the linked repository. Facebook is optional: Enable Facebook contacts in the popup, grant site access, sign in to a test Facebook account in Chrome and open Friends > All friends or Home with the Contacts panel visible. Open the Facebook widget in HABITAT. Only loaded contacts are shown. Disable Facebook contacts revokes access.
